description: This file defines the UploadFile class responsible for managing file uploads within the SuiteCRM system. It includes functionalities for handling file validation, malware scanning, MIME type detection, file storage, and integration with external APIs for document management.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: Main class managing file uploads, handling validation, storage, malware scanning, and external API interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance of UploadFile with the specified form field name.

methods.name: set_for_soap
methods.description: Prepares the object for a SOAP upload with a given filename and file content.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Deprecated; generates a URL path for a document based on filename and bean ID.

methods.name: get_upload_url
methods.description: Returns the URL to access an uploaded document related to a specific SugarBean.

methods.name: tryRename
methods.description: Attempts to rename a file to associate it with a specific bean ID.

methods.name: get_file_path
methods.description: Builds a URL path to the uploaded file, trying to handle encoding and renaming.

methods.name: duplicate_file
methods.description: Duplicates an uploaded file associated with an old ID to a new ID.

methods.name: get_upload_error
methods.description: Retrieves the upload error code from the PHP $_FILES array.

methods.name: confirm_upload
methods.description: Performs security and system checks to confirm a valid file upload and scans for malware.

methods.name: getMimeSoap
methods.description: Guesses the MIME type for SOAP uploads.

methods.name: getMime
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: get_stored_file_name
methods.description: Returns the stored filename.

methods.name: get_temp_file_location
methods.description: Returns the temporary file location.

methods.name: get_uploaded_file_name
methods.description: Returns the original name of the uploaded file.

methods.name: get_mime_type
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: get_file_contents
methods.description: Reads and returns the contents of the uploaded file.

methods.name: create_stored_filename
methods.description: Generates a filename for storage, considering system specifics.

methods.name: final_move
methods.description: Moves the uploaded temporary file to a permanent location based on bean ID.

methods.name: upload_doc
methods.description: Uploads a document to an external service if specified, with error handling.

methods.name: get_upload_path
methods.description: Constructs an upload path using the bean ID.

methods.name: unlink_file
methods.description: Deletes a specified uploaded file.

methods.name: get_upload_dir
methods.description: Returns the upload directory prefix.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Provides the real filesystem path of an uploaded file.

methods.name: relativeName
methods.description: Returns the path of the uploaded file relative to the uploads directory.
